phrases.note: Band lương. Số của bạn, đừng bịa trên app.

example.en: I'm targeting 2.4 to 2.8 billion VND total.

phrases.en: What's the range for this level?
phrases.vi: Range level này là sao ạ?

example.en: What's the range for this level in Vietnam / remote?
example.vi: Range level này ở VN / remote sao ạ?

example.en: I'm flexible on title if the scope is right.
example.vi: Title linh hoạt nếu scope đúng.

phrases.note: Nhắc equity/bonus. Không hỏi sớm vòng 1 trừ khi họ hỏi.

example.en: I care about total comp, not just base.
example.vi: Mình nhìn total, không chỉ base.

pattern.title: Comp in one breath
pattern.pattern: I'm targeting… What's the range for this level? Notice period is… Total comp, not just base
pattern.explainVi: Lương: band của bạn, hỏi range, notice, title linh hoạt, nhìn total. Điền số thật. Không mặc cả vòng 1 trừ khi họ hỏi.

aiPrompt.scenario: Recruiter asks for comp. Learner uses THEIR real band and notice. Don't invent a number in the prompt.
aiPrompt.system: You are a software interviewer at a foreign company. Speak natural interview English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra interview English so the learner practices listening. Interrupt with a follow-up. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: I'm targeting…; What's the range for this level?; Notice period is…; I'm flexible on title; Total comp, not just base. Ask about their real experience.
